ayahs.en: Woe to those who give less [than due],

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا اكۡتَالُوۡا عَلَي النَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُوۡنَؗۖ‏
ayahs.en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

ayahs.tl: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon
ayahs.en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
For a tremendous Day -
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا٘ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡفُجَّارِ لَفِيۡ سِجِّيۡنٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen
ayahs.en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Who deny the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهٖ٘ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ اَثِيۡمٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem
ayahs.en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

ayahs.ar: اِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen
ayahs.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا بَلۡࣝ رَانَ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ عَنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّمَحۡجُوۡبُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon
ayahs.en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon
ayahs.en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا٘ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الۡاَبۡرَارِ لَفِيۡ عِلِّيِّيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
On adorned couches, observing.
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

ayahs.ar: خِتٰمُهٗ مِسۡكٌؕ وَفِيۡ ذٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ الۡمُتَنٰفِسُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon
ayahs.en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
And its mixture is of Tasneem,
A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اَجۡرَمُوۡا كَانُوۡا مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَؗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا انۡقَلَبُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهِمُ انۡقَلَبُوۡا فَكِهِيۡنَؗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen
ayahs.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon
ayahs.en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

ayahs.ar: فَالۡيَوۡمَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مِنَ الۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon
ayahs.en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
On adorned couches, observing.

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ الۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
